scope.instruction:
Local test instance of a restaurant reservation app: Nuxt frontend on :3002 (proxies /api/** to the
API), Fastify API on :3001 with no prefix. Non-destructive basic pentest. Test accounts (seeded): admin / host /
venueadmin, venue slug 'bali'. Check the password in apps/api/prisma/seed.ts. Focus: unauthenticated access to
/staff/* and /admin/*, role escalation (host -> admin, venueadmin -> super-admin actions such as floor-plan/image
upload), IDOR on reservation/guest/venue ids, public reservation code guessing (/public/reservations/:code and
cancel/feedback), mass assignment on POST /public/venues/:slug/reservations, login brute force/enumeration, cookie
flags, CORS (CORS_ORIGIN is unset so any origin is reflected with credentials), stored XSS via guest name/notes
rendered in /host, /admin, /guests/:id, CSV formula injection in /admin/venues/:id/export.csv, SVG upload XSS,
verbose errors, source maps. Skip /ingest/**. Report PoC + fix per finding.

agents.task: Test login brute-force/enumeration, session/cookie flags, JWT/auth behavior, verbose errors and source maps on both ports. Non-destructive, bounded. Spawn validation/reporting children for confirmed vulnerabilities and record coverage.

Test unauthenticated /staff/* and /admin/* plus role escalation and IDOR across reservation/guest/venue IDs on API/frontend. Use seeded roles admin/host/venueadmin and password from available runtime hints. Non-destructive PoCs. If candidate confirmed, create nested validation/reporting agents per workflow. Record coverage.

Confirmed reflected CORS with credentials on API. File vulnerability report with PoC and inline fix. Evidence: GET /admin/venues with Cookie gioi_session and Origin http://evil.example returned 200 and access-control-allow-origin reflected evil + allow-credentials true (Caido request id 218); unauthenticated baseline same endpoint 401 request 219; preflight OPTIONS id 524. Explain impact authenticated cross-origin read on HTTPS deployment, fix strict allowlist. Include code locations only if source available; otherwise black-box report. Target http://host.docker.internal:3001 endpoint /admin/venues. Do not duplicate existing reports.

Validate reflected CORS with credentials on API/public reservation and authenticated endpoints. Demonstrate concrete unauthorized impact if possible using seeded accounts; non-destructive. If confirmed, spawn reporting child yourself with PoC+fix. Record coverage.

You are reporting agent for confirmed CSV formula injection on API admin export. Target http://host.docker.internal:3001. Evidence: unauthenticated public POST /public/venues/bali/reservations with guestName =HYPERLINK("http://x","x") created reservation GIOI-V93TGH7M; authenticated admin GET /admin/venues/01a1b416-566e-7288-9725-6c2b92ad2bed/export.csv returns CSV guest_name quoted as "=HYPERLINK(""http://x"",""x"")" without neutralization. Proxy exchange IDs export 1616/1614 and public POST likely find via list_requests. File create_vulnerability_report with PoC, counterevidence, CVSS appropriate (authenticated admin export consuming attacker-controlled public data; likely medium). Include http_exchange_ids. No source code available, so no code_locations. Record coverage reported.

Validate CSV formula injection on API admin venue export. Use seeded admin/password and reservation guestName beginning =HYPERLINK. Confirm export lacks neutralization, capture evidence, then spawn reporting child if confirmed. Target http://host.docker.internal:3001. Record coverage.

Test API and frontend proxy for SQL injection, NoSQL/command/template injection, SSRF/XXE where applicable. Start from mapped endpoints; bounded non-destructive sprays. Spawn validation/reporting children per candidate and record coverage.

Assess POST /public/venues/bali/reservations for mass assignment and business logic; test public reservation code guessing, cancel and feedback endpoints. Keep non-destructive (create then clean up only if safe). Spawn validation/reporting children for confirmed issues. Record coverage.

Map Fastify API at http://host.docker.internal:3001 comprehensively: endpoints, auth roles/accounts, parameters, technologies, and basic non-destructive recon. Inspect source if available. Record coverage and notes; do not deep exploit yet. Call get_threat_model first; if absent derive provisional findings and amend/save model.

Map Nuxt frontend at http://host.docker.internal:3002: crawl routes, source maps/assets, proxy behavior, staff/admin/host/guest surfaces, technologies. Non-destructive recon only. Call get_threat_model first and record coverage/notes.

URLs: - http://host.docker.internal:3002 - http://host.docker.internal:3001

Test stored XSS in guest name/notes rendered host/admin/guests, SVG upload XSS, CSV formula injection in admin venue export. Use safe canary payloads and seeded accounts, non-destructive. Any candidate must spawn validation then reporting child. Record coverage.

entries.surface: Application source repository / route and model mapping
entries.evidence: No source checkout or package manifests are present under /workspace; semgrep, secrets, trivy, and AST passes could only scan captured frontend HTML, so route handlers, auth guards, and data models remain unverified.
Dynamic validation confirmed Nuxt dev build and unauthenticated transformed source/Vite assets; vuln-0002 filed with HTTP evidence and remediation.
Authenticated cross-origin read was demonstrated on /admin/venues with reflected Origin and credentials; vuln-0001 filed.

entries.surface: Nuxt frontend :3002 routes, static assets, Vite source paths
entries.risk_area: information disclosure / source maps / route mapping
entries.evidence: Nuxt dev server exposes absolute filesystem paths in HTML and serves transformed source files under `/_nuxt/Users/.../apps/web/`; `@vite/client`, page modules, stores and composables are retrievable unauthenticated. Parent should file source disclosure finding with PoC.

entries.surface: Fastify API route registration and public endpoints
entries.evidence: Reviewed runtime route registration and source for all public, auth, staff, admin, and floor-plan routes; no exploit attempted in recon phase.
Confirmed seeded accounts authenticate with password `password`; cookie observed HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, Max-Age 604800. No deep brute-force or bypass testing performed in mapping task.
Static source review mapped requireAuth/requireVenueAccess/requireAdmin usage per route; no exploit validation performed. Parent agents should test IDOR and role boundaries.

entries.surface: Nuxt frontend :3002 dev assets and source endpoints
entries.risk_area: Unauthenticated source disclosure / exposed development server
entries.evidence: Unauthenticated GET / returns Nuxt dev HTML with absolute local paths and /_nuxt/@vite/client; direct GET /_nuxt/composables/useApi.ts and /_nuxt/stores/auth.ts return application source (HTTP 200). Filed report with exchanges 186, 433, 403, and 526.

entries.risk_area: Reflected CORS with credentials / cross-origin data disclosure
entries.evidence: Origin http://evil.example is reflected with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials:true on preflight and authenticated GET; with a valid session cookie, /admin/venues returned venue data readable cross-origin (request 218), while unauthenticated baseline returned 401 (219). Reporting child spawned.

entries.risk_area: route exposure and unauthenticated staff/admin access
entries.evidence: Direct unauthenticated and role-based API tests completed: staff/admin routes require auth; host and venueadmin privilege boundaries returned 403; no frontend-only bypass reached protected data.

Authenticated request 218 from Origin http://evil.example returned 200 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin reflecting the attacker origin and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true; unauthenticated baseline 219 returned 401 and preflight 524 succeeded.

Created reservations with injected status, role, isAdmin, ownerId, userId, venueId, id, and nested-like extras; response persisted only pending state and server-selected venue/seating. Party size bounds, opening hours, lead time, and capacity were enforced.

entries.risk_area: Login brute force, username enumeration, authentication errors
entries.evidence: Invalid and valid usernames with wrong passwords returned identical 401 ERR_UNAUTHORIZED responses; five rapid attempts were all processed without lockout, but no account compromise or differentiated error was demonstrated.
Valid code returned only booking summary; random, altered, lowercase, and near-miss codes returned 404. Codes are 8-character high-entropy alphanumeric values; no unauthorized record was obtained.

entries.surface: gioi_session cookie on POST /staff/login and logout
entries.risk_area: Session cookie flags and logout invalidation
entries.evidence: Login sets HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, Max-Age=604800; replayed session authenticated /staff/me and logout invalidated it. Logout clears cookie and server-side session.

Cancellation requires a valid booking code; random and modified codes returned 404. Valid-code cancellation transitions pending to cancelled and repeated invalid variants did not affect other reservations.

entries.risk_area: SQL injection / NoSQL / template or command injection
entries.evidence: Sprayed quote, boolean, stacked/time-delay, template, and prototype-pollution payloads; sqlmap against availability found no injectable parameter. Strict date/time/party validation blocks malformed values, and reservation strings are stored without execution.
Login payloads with SQL tautologies and JSON operator objects returned 401 or schema 400; no authentication bypass observed.

Feedback endpoint rejected valid-code reservations while pending and after cancellation with ERR_NOT_COMPLETED; arbitrary ratings and fields did not bypass completion requirement. No completed reservation fixture was available for end-to-end feedback persistence.

entries.surface: Fastify malformed requests and unknown routes
entries.evidence: Malformed JSON/schema failures expose only generic validation messages; unknown routes return structured 404 without stack traces, filesystem paths, or SQL details.
Proxy forwarded malformed date to API and returned generic 500 without reflection or execution; direct API sqlmap tests were negative.

entries.surface: Public reservation and venue routes (URL/XML processing)
entries.evidence: Mapped public API accepts reservation fields and venue/date parameters only; extra URL/callback fields are ignored, and no XML parser, fetch/import, webhook, or remote-resource processing endpoint was exposed in the mapped surface.

entries.surface: Nuxt development assets and source maps under /_nuxt
entries.risk_area: Source-map and development artifact information disclosure
entries.evidence: Source disclosure was dynamically confirmed across page modules, maps, Vite client, and API source; vuln-0002 covers this exposure.

Injected `<svg onload=alert(1)>` as public guestName and examined compiled Nuxt render paths: guestName and guestNotes are emitted via Vue `_toDisplayString` text interpolation (HTML-escaped) across host/admin/guest pages; no v-html/innerHTML sink found.

entries.surface: PUT /admin/venues/:id/floor-plan/image SVG upload and floor-plan rendering
entries.evidence: Admin endpoint accepts SVG data URI, but returned content is used as image data in the floor-plan UI; SVG script/event payload is inert in an `` browsing context, and no HTML/innerHTML sink was identified in compiled Nuxt code. Raw SVG acceptance remains a hardening concern but no executable XSS impact was demonstrated.

Authenticated admin tested quote/boolean/stacked/time payloads in q/search/venueId. q/search are ignored or safely return data; venueId malformed values produce generic 500/UUID validation behavior, valid UUIDs return scoped results, and no timing or tautology oracle was observed.
GET /staff/me, /staff/day, /staff/guests, /admin/venues and /admin/users return 401 without a session; valid POST /staff/reservations also returns 401 after schema validation.

entries.surface: Role escalation: host/venueadmin against /admin and floor-plan/image actions
entries.evidence: Host and venueadmin receive 403 super admin required for POST /admin/venues and PUT /admin/venues/{bali}/floor-plan/image; /admin/users is not accessible after valid schema.

entries.surface: Cross-venue IDOR on staff guest/reservation object IDs
entries.evidence: Host and venueadmin requests for Ubud guest and reservation IDs return 403 venue not accessible; same-venue records are available as intended. Admin can access cross-venue records by super-admin role.

Unauthenticated public reservation accepted guestName =HYPERLINK(...); authenticated admin export returned the value unchanged as a formula-leading CSV field (booking GIOI-V93TGH7M). Filed as vuln-0003.

Unauthenticated public reservation accepted guestName beginning `=HYPERLINK(...)`; authenticated admin CSV export returned the formula-leading value without a protective apostrophe/tab prefix. Filed as vuln-0003.

gaps.surface: Application source repository / route and model mapping
gaps.detail: No source checkout or package manifests are present under /workspace; semgrep, secrets, trivy, and AST passes could only scan captured frontend HTML, so route handlers, auth guards, and data models remain unverified.
Agent(s) CORS Reporting, CORS Validator were assigned the 'csrf' skill, but no coverage entry records this class being assessed. Treat it as unexamined, not as clean.
Agent(s) XSS Upload Export were assigned the 'insecure_file_uploads' skill, but no coverage entry records this class being assessed. Treat it as unexamined, not as clean.
CSV Formula Validator ran (status: completed) without recording any coverage. Whatever it examined is absent from this record.
